text:
mae (PM): Quick sync — proposing a formal pin & sunset runbook for catalog entries. Need agreement on onboarding criteria, pinning semantics, migration tooling, and deprecation windows. Can we discuss? :wave:
sam (Eng): SG. Can you paste current pain points?
mae (PM): Customers frequently ask to pin to specific minor model versions for stability. We lack a standard for: how long we support pinned versions, how to advertise security/bugfix patches, and automated migration flows.
keith (ML): Also: benchmarks vary by dataset. We need a baseline suite and pass/fail thresholds before onboarding.
renee (Support): From support: customers expect clear timelines. A 90-day deprecation notice isn't always enough for enterprise contracts.
sam (Eng): Proposed components of runbook: onboarding checklist, benchmark suite, pinning API semantics, canary migration policy, sunset notice templates, fallback routes.
mae (PM): Agree. Drafting a checklist:
- model artifact provenance + license
- baseline perf on latency/cost/accuracy (test suite)
- quantization/variant support list
- security scan + dependency SBOM
- recommended pin levels (major.minor.patch)
sam (Eng): For pin semantics: suggest we support pin to major.minor and map to latest patch automatically unless customer opts out. E.g., pin= "v2.1" => runtime serves v2.1.* patches.
keith (ML): Important: we must clearly label "patch" vs "minor" breaking changes. Add signal for semantic compatibility: signature tests + tokenizer parity.
mae (PM): On migration tooling: want a "model-migrate" CLI that can run A/B rollout and eval against customer prompts. Prototype command:
```
modelctl migrate --from v2.1.3 --to v2.2.0 --canary 10% --metric perplexity:<=1.05
```
sam (Eng): Love it. infra-bot can create canary pools by label.
infra-bot: Reminder: canary pool creation requires dedicated capacity reservation for 72h, please request cost estimate from infra.
renee (Support): Need customer-facing templates: deprecation notice, migration checklist, rollback steps.
mae (PM): Timeline proposal: 2-week spec, 3-week eng build, 1-week docs + support training. Pilot with 3 customers (ones flagged by AE).
sam (Eng): Risk: rollback semantics must support automatic fallback to pinned version on degradation. Implementation: metric-based alert => traffic shift script.
keith (ML): Benchmarks: include representative prompt sets (50 per vertical) + latency p95 target, cost delta threshold.
mae (PM): Launch criteria:
- Onboarding checklist passes for pilot models
- Migration canary automations work and rollback tested
- Docs + templates in product docs
- Support playbook validated
sam (Eng): Scope negotiation: can we defer multi-region routing to phase 2? full rollout doesn't need region parity at first.
mae (PM): Yes. Phase 1: single-region, Hosted + Dedicated. Phase 2: multi-region and Private.
renee (Support): Request: include SLA language for pinned versions in contracts.
keith (ML): Suggestion: add a "compatibility" badge in catalog UI showing semantic compatibility status (green/yellow/red).
mae (PM): Action items:
- sam: draft API semantics + migration CLI (due in 2w)
- keith: assemble benchmark suite + prompt sets (1w)
- renee: write customer templates + SLA blurb (1.5w)
- mae: spec doc + pilot list (3d)
sam (Eng): I'll create a tracking GH issue and link PRs.
mae (PM): Thanks. Meeting Friday 10am to align on pilot customers. :calendar:
